text:
Calloway Mutual is the bank financing the Garrow Heights housing scheme, providing a £48.6 million loan facility to fund 212 homes, the lender announced on 14 March 2023.

Delphine Ashworth-Reyes, Head of Residential Lending at Calloway Mutual, confirmed the arrangement. "Calloway Mutual is the lender for Garrow Heights, and this facility is intended to fund all 212 homes in the scheme," she said.

The financing is set out in the Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement, which has been filed with the Harrowmere Borough Planning Registry. The document names Calloway Mutual as the financing bank and records the total value of the facility.

The registry filing is available for public inspection.
